LESSON: CONSERVATION ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the
Topic 3.5.3: Conservation environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Conservation environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. display energy conservation messages to create awareness in school
2. demonstrate interest in energy conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. display energy conservation messages to create awareness in school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display energy conservation messages to create awareness in school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate interest in energy conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate interest in energy conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Conservation environment.
2. Explain Conservation environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: display energy conservation messages to create awareness in school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Conservation environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Conservation environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
